[h3][b]💚 Friends, we did it![/b][/h3]

Our visual novel "Sorrel Coffee" has finally been released - and now it's yours 🎉 Months of development, dozens of scenes redrawn, hundreds of lines of code and countless cups of real coffee - we're happy to present you the game we've been dreaming of.

And it's already waiting for you on Steam - with a 15% discount on the occasion of the release! 👇

[i]You find yourself in a strange cafe where everyone insists that you have a cup of sorrel coffee. But beware: every sip resets reality, and you find yourself in a new world full of mystery and danger. Who are you? Why has your memory been erased? And why are monster girls and armed agents after you? 👀[/i]

A great reason to dive into the mysterious world at a better price 💸

❤️ Thank you for being with us all this time

Your interest, support and every kind word helped us go from idea to release.

notes.title: Devlog: Showing the artbook and wallpapers
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500726/914827ccdf32da65c36313906cecc87227c41f2c.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Hello, friends!✨[/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3511020/I_drink_Sorrel_Coffee_to_reboot_reality_but_Im_being_hunted_by_Monster_Girls_and_armed_agents/
As you know, [b]the release of our visual novel "Sorrel Coffee" is just around the corner[/b] — we’re almost there! While you wait for the main game to come out, today we’d like to tell you about two additional items that are nearly finished: [b]an artbook and a set of wallpapers[/b], specially created for fans of the project.

[h3][b]📖 Artbook: Behind the Scenes of Game Development[/b][/h3]

In the artbook, we’ve gathered all the most interesting content from the development process:

🎨 Character and illustration sketches with explanations
🎨 Intermediate versions of artworks and their final look
🎨 Information about character design and attributes
🎨 Fun facts about the game and its characters

This isn’t just a collection of images — it’s a full guide to the world of Sorrel Coffee , giving you deeper insight into how our game came to life.

Today, we’re sharing a few pages from the artbook so you can get a glimpse of what’s waiting for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500726/d47f3a8f0248f0482416f9f2fbcafb2583c8ea95.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500726/a47f127b235db25f905f90ffba96dbf116b4e888.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]🖥️ Wallpapers: Bring the Beauty of the Game to Your Desktop[/b][/h3]

In addition to the artbook, we’ve prepared a set of high-quality wallpapers featuring your favorite moments and characters from the game. This is a great way to surround yourself with the cozy café atmosphere even when you're not playing — or simply enjoy beautiful artwork every day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500726/86a1c5ded9c4f7aafcee83238ce8ce9c4c89511e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500726/a58b51674b6934d8b858b3dac0fd210bc6351cdc.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]🙏 Thank You & Reminder[/b][/h3]

A huge thank you to everyone who continues to support us and the project! We’re working down to the last pixel to make sure you get not only an engaging story but also a complete aesthetic experience.

Add to wishlist on Steam — in order not to miss the game release 💫

notes.title: 🍵Devlog: What's new in the world of Sorrel Coffee? 🌱
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500726/74dd3ca4c1d0c5052059c6e6269540160dcdf4d4.jpg[/img]
[h3]🍵[b]Devlog: What's new in the world of Sorrel Coffee?[/b] 🌱[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3511020/I_drink_Sorrel_Coffee_to_reboot_reality_but_Im_being_hunted_by_Monster_Girls_and_armed_agents/
It's time to share the latest news about our game development. Every day we are getting closer to the moment when you will be able to fully immerse yourself in our mysterious world. And here's what happened during this time:

[b]✅ The entire script has been contributed to the code![/b]
The story is now part of the game, and every line of dialog is ready to tell you its secrets.

[b]⏳ Work on the art continues:[/b]
Our artist is tirelessly creating stunning images for each scene. Today we want to show you some sketches with our favorite Kiki!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500726/8a61f9f8b878da28481605f8dc39a57ab7ff00c2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500726/1549d28d7f803f936ff74ccfe63513e0ecef0e59.jpg[/img]
[b]✨ Added interactivity in some scenes:[/b]
We decided to make the game even more interesting and added additional interaction elements. Now some scenes not only tell a story, but also allow you to actively influence what is happening. This should dilute the narrative and make it more exciting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500726/6feb27ebae5a6e587bd623ef38ad73b6b3a6f287.jpg[/img]
[b]📅 The second update of the demo is coming![/b]
In the next demo update you will be able to dive into other story branches and learn more about the mysteries of our world. You'll soon be able to check out these changes for yourself - stay tuned!

Thanks to everyone who supports us with their attention and feedback. Your interest gives us the strength to move forward. See you in the next devlog! ☕

notes.title: Sorrel Coffee: A fresh devlog🍵
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500726/a720bc97328b72a066cb5cee3b309cc5b6a985da.jpg[/img]
[b][h3]Hello, connoisseurs of sorrel coffee! A fresh devlog is on the menu today!🍵[/h3][/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3511020/I_drink_Sorrel_Coffee_to_reboot_reality_but_Im_being_hunted_by_Monster_Girls_and_armed_agents/

Let's take a look behind the scenes of development and share the ingredients that go into making our game. First and foremost, we are proud of our beautiful characters, and today we present to you the sketches of the three main heroines! 💕 Each of them could become your waifu. And next up—concepts of the monsters you might encounter 😏

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500726/d78f8d0551a9e024c2243b4aa51f0efaef39540f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500726/9ff1b7280ca95f72e7bf6e72aa1b7dadca592370.jpg[/img]
As you can see, judging by the sketches, work on Sorrel Coffee is well underway! Every day brings us closer to the final result, and we can't wait to share it with you.

[h3][b]The process of working on the build:[/b][/h3]
✅ The script is finished! The story is already waiting to tell you its secrets.
⏳ Building the game: putting text into the code, customizing scenes and dialogue routes.
⏳ Art: now that the story has been finalized, our talented artist can fully dive in creating art for each route.
⏳ Starting work on the 18+ DLC - scenes are written and artwork has begun.
⏳ Starting work on localizations. What languages would you like to see in the game? Write in the comments, we'll be glad to know your opinion!

What do you think of the progress? What else would you like to know about the development? Share your thoughts in the comments - we are always open to feedback!
